scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'fs'; ['apps/agency/dist', 'apps/main-web/dist', 'apps/shop/dist', 'apps/blog/dist', 'apps/operators/dist', 'apps/settings/dist', 'apps/admin/dist', 'apps/subdomeny/dist'].forEach(d => fs.existsSync(d) && fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })); console.log('🧹 [V20 CLEANUP]: Staré buildy (dist) boli kompletne vymazané!');"
scripts.postbuild: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'fs'; if(fs.existsSync('apps/subdomeny/dist')) { fs.cpSync('apps/subdomeny/dist', 'apps/main-web/dist/subdomeny', { recursive: true }); console.log('⚡ [V20 BUILD]: Subdomény úspešne zlúčené do main-web/dist!'); }" && npm run snap
scripts.snap:git: git add . && git commit -m "⚡ [V20 SNAPSHOT]: Operational Checkpoint Deployment" && git push origin main
